name: openbb_economy_interest_rate
description:
Meant to give short-term interest rates by country from the OECD through OpenBB (obb.economy.short_term_interest_rate).
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): country (default united_states); provider (schema default oecd; when omitted the tool sends yfinance).
OpenBB 4.x (4.6 checked) has no obb.economy.short_term_interest_rate (4.6 has obb.economy.interest_rates), so this tool currently returns an error object; alternatives: fred_fed_funds_rate, openbb_fixedincome_sofr or the central bank tools.
Example: {"country": "japan", "provider": "oecd"}
